Form Notes: Lie flat on the bench, grip behind your head, and curl your pelvis/hips upward off the pad; lower slowly with control instead of swinging your legs.
Kneel on a pad holding a barbell loaded with round plates; brace your abs and squeeze glutes to tuck your pelvis under so your lower back never sags as you roll forward.
Hold one heavy dumbbell at your side like a suitcase, keep your ribcage stacked over your pelvis, and walk slowly without leaning toward or away from the weight.
Hold a dumbbell or plate against your upper chest/chin, exhale hard, and curl your ribcage toward your pelvis without pulling on your neck; progress weight over time.
Set up in a high plank with feet slightly wider than hip-width; reach across underneath your torso to drag a dumbbell from one side to the other without letting your hips twist.
On hands and knees with a neutral spine, extend opposite arm and leg straight out, pause for 2 full seconds while bracing your abs, and avoid arching your lower back.
